findings.evidence: Line 402 `@[expose, simps obj map] noncomputable def indFDRepFunctor` generates `indFDRepFunctor_map`/`indFDRepFunctor_obj` (docstring at 397-401 names both); `mathlib/Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Functor/Basic.lean:126 @[simp, grind =] theorem comp_map (F : C ⥤ D) (G : D ⥤ E) (f : X ⟶ Y) : (F ⋙ G).map f = G.map (F.map f) := rfl`. The diff line `-    -- Naturality is the cancellation of the conjugating isomorphisms in \`indFDRepMap\`.` shows the comment was dropped without replacement.
findings.fix: Replace `change ...` with `simp only [CategoryTheory.Functor.comp_map, indFDRepFunctor_map, indFDRepFunctor_obj]`; if some step genuinely has no lemma, keep the `change` but state in a comment which reduction is unavailable.
findings.issue: The `change` at 418-420 is now uncommented — this PR removed the comment that justified it — and it unfolds `(indFDRepFunctor ⋙ forget₂).map f`/`.obj A` by raw defeq, bypassing the `@[simps obj map]` projections the docstring at 397-401 declares to be the interface.

findings.evidence: mathlib/Mathlib/RepresentationTheory/Rep/Basic.lean:113 `@[simp] lemma hom_comp`; mathlib/Mathlib/RepresentationTheory/Intertwining.lean:215-217 `@[simp] lemma comp_toLinearMap`; `LinearMap.comp_apply` is `@[simp]`; local `indFDRepMap_apply` (line 355) and `indFDRepForgetIso_hom_hom_apply` (line 328) both carry `@[simp]`. The proof already terminates with a bare `simp`, so simp is capable in this context.
findings.fix: Delete the `rw`/`simp only` block and close with `ext x; simp` (add `[Representation.IntertwiningMap.toLinearMap_apply]` to the simp set if the non-simp `toLinearMap_apply` step is needed).
findings.issue: Lines 422-428 are a brittle chain of nine named rewrites (`Rep.hom_comp` ×2, `IntertwiningMap.comp_toLinearMap` ×2, `LinearMap.comp_apply` ×2, `toLinearMap_apply`, `indFDRepMap_apply`, `indFDRepForgetIso_hom_hom_apply` ×2) ending in `simp`; every lemma in the chain is already a `simp` lemma, so the chain only pins the proof to Mathlib's current naming.

summary: The defeq handling around `indFDRepMap` is now properly factored into named `rfl` lemmas, but the rewritten naturality proof of `indFDRepForgetNatIso` keeps an undocumented `change` (its justifying comment was deleted by this PR) and a nine-step named-lemma chain in front of a terminal `simp`, all of whose steps are already `@[simp]`.
